posts.title: Software Engineering: Income over the Course of a Career
posts.description: A Software Engineer’s Annual Gross Income ( AGI ) over 35 years, adjusted for inflation. AGI is a US tax measurement of an individual’s total gross income minus specific deductions. This is a chart that displays my AGI for the years 1987 through 2025 relative to my 1987 AGI, adjusted for inflation. For example, in 1987 the number is 1.0 (my 1987 AGI is 1.0✕ my 1987 AGI). posts.title: What's at the Other End of 8.8.8.8?
posts.description: 8.8.8.8 is Google’s “ free, global DNS resolution service ”, so popular that it’s been lampooned by XKCD . It has a wonderfully straightforward front-end: the IP address 8.8.8.8 . But that begs the question: what’s on the back-end? Do the authoritative nameservers receive queries from 8.8.8.8 or some other IP address?
